name: projects
description: The life of a project, kept in its README: /projects:new interviews for the finish line, people, versioning and sensitivity; /projects:adopt adds what an existing project lacks; hold, board, pickup and close pause, show, resume and archive it; /projects:pair runs a product-manager session and a Claude Code engineer through a mailbox. A session-start line says where the folder's project stands and which of its resources this machine has not mapped.
